name: ivs-realtime
description: The Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS) real-time API is REST compatible, using a standard HTTP API and an AWS EventBridge event stream for responses.

subcommands.name: create-encoder-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an EncoderConfiguration object.

subcommands.name: create-ingest-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a new IngestConfiguration resource, used to specify the ingest protocol for a stage.

subcommands.name: create-participant-token
subcommands.description: Creates an additional token for a specified stage.

subcommands.name: create-stage
subcommands.description: Creates a new stage (and optionally participant tokens).

subcommands.name: create-storage-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a new storage configuration, used to enable recording to Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: delete-encoder-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes an EncoderConfiguration resource.

subcommands.name: delete-ingest-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified IngestConfiguration, so it can no longer be used to broadcast.

subcommands.name: delete-public-key
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified public key used to sign stage participant tokens.

subcommands.name: delete-stage
subcommands.description: Shuts down and deletes the specified stage (disconnecting all participants).

subcommands.name: delete-storage-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the storage configuration for the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: disconnect-participant
subcommands.description: Disconnects a specified participant from a specified stage.

subcommands.name: get-composition
subcommands.description: Get information about the specified Composition resource.

subcommands.name: get-encoder-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified EncoderConfiguration resource.

subcommands.name: get-ingest-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified IngestConfiguration.

subcommands.name: get-participant
subcommands.description: Gets information about the specified participant token.

subcommands.name: get-public-key
subcommands.description: Gets information for the specified public key.

subcommands.name: get-stage
subcommands.description: Gets information for the specified stage.

subcommands.name: get-stage-session
subcommands.description: Gets information for the specified stage session.

subcommands.name: get-storage-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the storage configuration for the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: import-public-key
subcommands.description: Import a public key to be used for signing stage participant tokens.

subcommands.name: list-compositions
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about all Compositions in your account, in the AWS region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-encoder-configurations
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about all EncoderConfigurations in your account, in the AWS region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-ingest-configurations
subcommands.description: Lists all IngestConfigurations in your account, in the AWS region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-participant-events
subcommands.description: Lists events for a specified participant that occurred during a specified stage session.

subcommands.name: list-participant-replicas
subcommands.description: Lists all the replicas for a participant from a source stage.

subcommands.name: list-participants
subcommands.description: Lists all participants in a specified stage session.

subcommands.name: list-public-keys
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about all public keys in your account, in the AWS region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-stage-sessions
subcommands.description: Gets all sessions for a specified stage.

subcommands.name: list-stages
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about all stages in your account, in the AWS region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-storage-configurations
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about all storage configurations in your account, in the AWS region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Gets information about AWS tags for the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: start-composition
subcommands.description: Starts a Composition from a stage based on the configuration provided in the request.

subcommands.name: start-participant-replication
subcommands.description: Starts replicating a publishing participant from a source stage to a destination stage.

subcommands.name: stop-composition
subcommands.description: Stops and deletes a Composition resource.

subcommands.name: stop-participant-replication
subcommands.description: Stops a replicated participant session.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for the AWS resource with the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the resource with the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: update-ingest-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates a specified IngestConfiguration.

subcommands.name: update-stage
subcommands.description: Updates a stage’s configuration.
